title: Humanity
definition: The doctrine of humanity teaches that human beings are created by God, dependent upon God, accountable to God, and made for fellowship with Him.
summary: Human life has dignity because it comes from God, but humanity is also fallen and in need of redemption. We were made to know, love, worship, and obey the Lord.
christFocus: Christ is the true and perfect Man. In Him, fallen people are redeemed, restored, and brought into the purpose for which humanity was created.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Humanity has dignity, responsibility, and dependence.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Humanity’s restoration comes through Christ, the last Adam.
